nodes.description: Address of the CEO role, initialized to msg.sender at deployment and mutable via setCEO.
Address of the CFO role, gates Withdraw/Set_EmergencyCode; reassignable through Use_EmergencyCode.
Address of the COO role, initialized to msg.sender and used in onlyCLevel checks.
Master owner address controlling onlyC_Meow_O functionality, reassignable via setCMO.
Secondary owner address used by onlyLuGoddess for setCMO and unpause.
Pause flag gating most state-mutating functions via whenNotPaused.
Emergency code value used by Use_EmergencyCode to attempt CFO takeover.
Emergency code companion value compared against msg.value in Use_EmergencyCode.
Total LuToken supply used as ERC20 totalSupply; mutated without overflow guards.
Mapping from user address to internal UserId used as identity key across the game and token logic.
Per-UserId LuToken balance mapping mutated by transfer, approve, exchange and settlement paths.
Untrusted caller identity used for role gating, randomness seeding and fund routing.
Timestamp (now) used as entropy source for card dealing randomness.
Owner-guarded function that reassigns ceoAddress.
Owner-guarded function that reassigns cfoAddress.
Owner-guarded function that reassigns cooAddress.
LuGoddess-guarded function that reassigns C_Meow_O_Address.
C-level function that sets paused to true.
LuGoddess-guarded public function that clears the paused flag.
Payable deposit that accepts ETH and emits an event without accounting.
CFO-guarded ETH withdrawal using msg.sender.transfer, exposed to reentrancy.
CFO-guarded setter that stores the emergency Code and Value.
Public payable function that reassigns cfoAddress to msg.sender when code and value match.
Payable ETH-to-LuToken conversion that mints tokens and increases total supply.
LuToken-to-ETH redemption that debits balances and pays out via low-level send.
Owner-guarded arbitrary external call forwarding msg.value and attacker-supplied calldata.
Public payable function that may transfer the entire contract balance to an attacker-chosen address.
Public payable function computing a payout in an unbounded loop then transferring to msg.sender.
ERC20 transfer that moves LuToken balances between mapped UserIds.
ERC20 approve that debits the sender balance and records an allowance.
ERC20 transferFrom that consumes allowance but credits the recipient balance without debiting the owner.
Public view randomness generator seeded with blockhash, msg.sender and timestamp; predictable.
Card dealer that calls the randomness function and pushes drawn cards.
Dealer action that on stand calls result determination and performs balance settlement.
Computes winners/losers using unbounded loops over player sets and memory arrays.
Internal game setup that writes Game_Unit state and depends on the card dealing path.
msg.sender.transfer(_Amount) external value transfer in Withdraw, reentrancy vector.
_GetPayAddress.send(LuTokenAmount * 98e12) low-level send to an arbitrary payable address.
_Address.call.value(msg.value)(_Data) arbitrary external call with attacker-controlled target and calldata.
_Address.transfer(address(this).balance + msg.value) drains the contract balance to a caller-chosen address.
msg.sender.transfer(TransferAmount) pays a loop-derived amount to the untrusted caller.
Arithmetic LuTokenAmount * 98e12 without overflow protection (Solidity 0.5 safe here but value scale mismatch).
Arithmetic TotalERC20Amount_LuToken - LuTokenAmount without underflow protection.
New CEO address parameter of setCEO.
New CMO address parameter of setCMO.
Withdrawal amount parameter of Withdraw.
Target UserId parameter of Exchange_ETH2LuToken.
Payee address parameter of Exchange_LuToken2ETH.
Redemption amount parameter of Exchange_LuToken2ETH.
Arbitrary call target parameter of CommandShell.
Arbitrary calldata parameter of CommandShell.
Recipient address parameter of Worship_LuGoddess.
Emergency code parameter of Set_EmergencyCode.
Emergency value parameter of Set_EmergencyCode.
Caller-supplied code parameter of Use_EmergencyCode.
Minted token amount derived from msg.value in Exchange_ETH2LuToken.
Caller UserId resolved from msg.sender in Exchange_LuToken2ETH.
Loop-derived payout amount in Donate_LuGoddess.
Intermediate multiplied value in the Donate_LuGoddess loop.
Random card index derived in GetCard.
Winner UserId iterated during settlement in Dealer_HitOrStand.

edges.reason: Withdraw performs an external msg.sender.transfer before finishing, allowing the recipient to reenter the contract.
Exchange_LuToken2ETH invokes a low-level send to an arbitrary payable address, enabling reentrant state reads before settlement.
CommandShell performs an arbitrary external call with caller-controlled calldata, enabling reentrancy or full hijack.
Worship_LuGoddess transfers the full balance plus msg.value to an attacker-chosen address, reentrancy-prone.
Donate_LuGoddess transfers a computed amount to msg.sender after a long loop, exposing the payout path.
The _Amount parameter flows directly into the external transfer.
The payee address parameter flows into the low-level send.
LuTokenAmount is multiplied by 98e12 to compute the ETH payout.
LuTokenAmount is subtracted from the total LuToken supply.
The target address parameter flows into the arbitrary external call.
The calldata parameter flows into the arbitrary external call.
The recipient address parameter flows into the balance transfer.
The _UserId parameter indexes the account whose minted amount is computed.
The minted LuToken amount is written into the balance mapping.
msg.sender is the recipient of the withdrawal transfer.
msg.sender is the recipient of the donation payout.
setCMO reassigns the master owner C_Meow_O_Address.
setCEO reassigns the CEO role address.
block.timestamp (now) is used as entropy in the randomness generator, making card deals predictable.
msg.sender is mixed into the randomness hash, allowing callers to influence the draw.
LuGoddess is initialized from msg.sender at deployment, granting permanent owner power.
cfoAddress is initialized from msg.sender at deployment.
cooAddress is initialized from msg.sender at deployment.
Use_EmergencyCode can reassign cfoAddress when the supplied code and msg.value match the stored secrets.
The untrusted caller supplies the code compared against the stored emergency secret.
MutiplyAmount accumulates in the loop and drives the payout TransferAmount.
TransferAmount is a loop-derived value used as the transfer amount.
GetCard calls the randomness generator to draw a card.
Dealer_HitOrStand invokes Determine_Result when the dealer stands.
Game initialization path triggers the card dealing logic via round setup.
Exchange_ETH2LuToken increases the total LuToken supply without overflow protection.
Exchange_LuToken2ETH decreases the total LuToken supply without underflow protection.
setCEO is guarded by onlyC_Meow_O comparing msg.sender at runtime.
Withdraw is guarded by onlyCFO comparing msg.sender to cfoAddress.
CommandShell is guarded by onlyC_Meow_O, but a compromised owner gains full arbitrary call power.
Use_EmergencyCode is public and gated only by matching code plus msg.value, enabling CFO takeover.
Worship_LuGoddess is publicly callable by any sender.
The control flow of Use_EmergencyCode writes the attacker identity into cfoAddress on success.

normalization_plan.reason: The _newCEO parameter is only meaningful as the input of setCEO and should be folded into that core function node.
The _newCMO parameter exists solely to be written into C_Meow_O_Address by setCMO.
The withdrawal amount is a direct dataflow source for the external transfer unsafe operation.
The _UserId parameter only selects the account credited by the exchange function.
The payee address flows straight into the low-level send operation.
The redemption amount drives both the multiplication and the outgoing send value.
The target address is used only as an argument of the arbitrary call.
The calldata is used only as an argument of the arbitrary call.
The recipient address flows directly into the balance-draining transfer.
The _Code parameter is stored by Set_EmergencyCode as the emergency secret.
The _Value parameter is stored by Set_EmergencyCode as the emergency comparison value.
The caller-supplied code is only relevant as the gate input of the emergency function.
The minted amount is a temporary computation local to the ETH-to-LuToken exchange.
The payer UserId is resolved and consumed entirely inside the redemption function.
The loop-computed amount is used only as the value of the donation transfer.
The intermediate multiplication value only exists to compute the donation payout.
The random card index is produced by and only meaningful relative to the randomness function.
The winner UserId local is iterated and consumed solely inside the settlement loop of the dealer action.
